# IDAROOM — إداروم

> Hybrid (online/offline) school management platform for Algerian schools. Unified digital badge, attendance, parent notifications, library, exams, trips, and behavior tracking.

IDAROOM is a complete school operating system designed for Algerian institutions. It supports Arabic, French, and English, works without the internet, and centralizes all daily operations around a single RFID badge.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, the 12 modules, and how the unified badge works.
- [About](/about): Design principles — hybrid online/offline, manual override, unified digital identity, multi-channel notifications, and security.
- [Trust & Security](/trust): How student, parent, and staff data is protected — access control, encryption, storage, retention, and incident reporting.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/login): Authentication for school staff, teachers, parents, and students.
